description: D3: while an attempt is running, is the executor progressing, blocked, looping or done? Code measures silence and repetition first; the model judges only what code cannot. Asked by `wait --assess` and `status --assess`; the answer never stops the run.

progressing.label: 在推进
progressing.instructions: `recent_output` and `recent_tools` show real progress toward `goal`: new files edited, new commands run, new results obtained. Restating the plan, re-reading the same files or summarising what was already done is not progress.

criteria.true: New concrete steps toward the goal appear in the recent output.
criteria.false: The recent output restates, re-plans, re-reads or repeats without new results.

blocked.label: 被挡住
blocked.instructions: The executor hit an error, a missing dependency, a contradiction in its instructions or a permission it cannot grant itself, and `recent_output` does not show it getting past that obstacle.

criteria.true: An unresolved obstacle is visible and the executor is not past it.
criteria.false: No obstacle is visible, or the executor already got past it.

looping.label: 在打转
looping.instructions: `recent_output` shows the same edit, command or line of reasoning repeated with no change in outcome. `output_is_repeating` is a measured fact about the text; judge whether the repetition is a loop rather than a legitimate retry that differs each time.

criteria.true: The same action is repeated with the same result.
criteria.false: Repeated actions differ or converge on a result.

done.label: 已完成
done.instructions: `goal` has been completed and the executor is writing, or has written, its final report; nothing of the task remains to be done.

criteria.true: The work is complete and only the final report remains.
criteria.false: Work is still in progress, or the report is not the final one.

action.label: 建议
action.instructions: What should the planner do about this run right now? Judge from the measured facts and the recent output. The run is never stopped by this answer; the planner only decides what to prepare.

criteria.keep_waiting: Work is underway and nothing is needed from the planner.
criteria.prepare_next_contract: The run has stalled, looped or is blocked in a way that will not resolve by itself; the planner should prepare the next contract version while this run finishes or times out.
criteria.collect: The goal looks finished; the planner should expect the run to end soon and prepare the review.
